identity_cost.detail: an Alibaba Cloud international-site account: registration takes an email address and a password, then a mobile number or an email code; 'If you registered your Alibaba Cloud account with an email address, you must complete secure phone number verification', and that number must match the Country/Region chosen at registration. The completed sign-up needs 'Mobile number, payment method, billing address', because the account must 'add payment information before you can buy paid cloud services in regions outside the Chinese mainland or activate the free trial of most paid services'. The Basic plan meters compute, 'you are still charged for any compute resources', so the payment method is the gate; the payment FAQ lists the method as 'such as a credit card or PayPal', and the international site 'does not support binding a mobile number of the Chinese mainland'.
